verdict.rationale: Runloop is a cloud sandbox platform that ships a CLI (rli), SDKs, and a dashboard, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents any telemetry setting, tracking disclosure, or opt-out mechanism. Egress network policies control what Devboxes can reach, not the vendor's own usage tracking, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.
